# Preview freezes when the report opens

## Outcome

The preview stays responsive when the report opens.

## Actual

The preview stops responding.

## Reproduction

- S1: Open the monthly report.
- S2: Select the preview tab.

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: The preview responds when the monthly report opens.
2. AC2: Readers can switch to the preview tab.

## Verification

- V1: Open the report and confirm the preview tab responds.
- V2: Regression test: Check that the monthly report preview responds.

## Out of scope

- Changing the report layout.
